title: Research
about: Questions that need several sources put together. At the complete level they also run through Deep Research, which nobody has timed yet.

questions.query: How did the printing press change Europe, and what did it lead to in science and religion?
questions.toRead: Gutenberg about 1450; cheaper books, the Reformation, the spread of scientific results.

questions.query: How were antibiotics discovered, and why is resistance now a global problem?
questions.toRead: Fleming 1928, penicillin; overuse and selection explain resistance.
